name: Projectile Motion
description: Launch a projectile and watch the parabola, flight time and range follow from the launch speed, angle, gravity and starting height.

name: Newton's Second Law
description: Vary the net force and mass to see the acceleration, and read displacement and momentum off a velocity–time graph.

name: Kinetic & Potential Energy
description: Drop a mass and watch gravitational potential energy convert to kinetic energy while the total stays constant.

name: Mass-Spring SHM
description: Oscillate a mass on a spring and track displacement, velocity, acceleration and the energy exchange over two periods.

name: Electric Field
description: Sweep the separation between two charges to see the inverse-square fall of force, field strength and potential.

name: Magnetic Force
description: Rotate the velocity relative to the field and watch F = Bqv sinθ peak at 90° and vanish when parallel.

name: Ideal Gas Law
description: Compress a gas at constant temperature and confirm that pressure rises as volume falls while pV stays fixed.

name: Photon Energy
description: Sweep the frequency to see photon energy rise linearly, with the Planck constant as the gradient.

name: Radioactive Decay
description: Follow an exponential decay across five half-lives, reading undecayed nuclei, decayed nuclei and activity.

name: Lorentz Factor
description: Increase the speed towards c and watch γ climb without limit, dilating time and contracting length.
